user.title: Elkron MP500
user.description: Connection to the local IT500WEB interface. If you have not changed the codes, keep the factory ones. Web Server user and password are optional: they are used once (a login of less than a second) to read the input names from the panel, and are NOT stored. Without them inputs are called "Ingresso 1, 2, 3..." and can be renamed in the options.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to communicate with the IT500WEB TCP interface.
error.connection_refused: Connection refused: the device is not accepting TCP connections on this port. Check the IP address, port, and IT500WEB TCP service.
error.web_busy: The Web Server is busy (someone is logged in). Try again shortly.
error.web_login_failed: Invalid Web Server user or password.
error.web_credentials_missing: Enter the Web Server user and password.
error.web_failed: Could not read the names from the Web Server. Check the log.
error.local_auth_failed: The panel refused the local login. Check the plant code and technical code; if they are right, close the app, Web Server and Hi-Connect, wait 2 minutes and try again.
error.invalid_plant_id: The plant code must be 8 digits.
error.invalid_tech_code: The technical code must be 4 to 8 digits.

init.title: Elkron MP500
init.description: Polling interval (from 1 s). To re-read names and sectors from the panel tick "Re-read names" and enter the Web Server user and password (they are not stored): hand-typed names are replaced by the panel's. Name and type of each input stay editable; the type decides whether you read Open/Closed or Detected. You choose the disarm code here, in Home Assistant: it is not a panel code. When set, Home Assistant asks for it before disarming; arming stays code-free.

data.web_user: Web Server user (only to re-read names)
data.web_password: Web Server password (only to re-read names, not stored)
data.disarm_code: Disarm code (6 digits, optional: empty = unchanged)
